【新增】
· 图片 / 视频模型改到对话里直接选：发送框切到媒体模式即可就地换模型，选过的会被记住，顶部下拉与发送框是同一份列表，不会再出现两处对不上
· 模型平台预设改为从后端权威列表同步，模型选择器新增 Ollama
· 免费体验模型新增计量代理供应商与充值入口

【改进】
· 安装后的程序名与安装目录统一为 One Work（此前壳层仍显示上一代品牌名）；正式版用户数据目录一并更名，首次启动自动迁移，迁移失败则原地沿用旧目录，数据不会丢
· 多图结果按张数自适应网格，列数与高度跟着张数走，不再裁掉画面
· 发送框的模型胶囊超长 id 会裁剪并在悬停时滚动，不再挤占整行
· 深色模式下单色的 Agent 图标不再看不见

【修复】
· macOS 安装包「已损坏、无法打开」根治：签名身份配置带前缀时会导致签名失败并静默降级成未签名包，现在签名失败直接中断发布，不会再把未签名包发出去
· 数据库损坏后的自愈会先结束仍占着文件的残留进程，失败后仍可重试——此前在 Windows 上会卡死在「恢复失败」
· 清理残留后端时不再误伤同名的其他进程
· 通过协议链接（dream://）启动时，深链能正确送达已在运行的窗口，而不是被丢弃
· Windows 上主进程拉起子进程不再闪黑框
· 自定义日志目录会如实上报，后端日志级别的重映射恢复生效
· 图片走中转网关时会在协议猜错后自动改用兄弟协议重试；视频的音频参数此前从未透传，中转网关路径生成的视频一律无声
· 安装包在某些机器上解不出主程序（E1010）的根因修复

【新增】
· 企业接入收敛为一个三步向导，连接与登录合并到同一页
· 成员侧企业记忆页
· 数字员工团队同步、组织内会话分享、管理员审计正文上传
· 渠道同步支持逐模型的协议覆盖

【改进】
· SSO 渠道不可用时直接说明原因，不再只是静默置灰
· 企业下发的渠道密钥在客户端一律打码
· 向导的编辑模式补上了上下文说明与退出口，输入框不再看不清
· 登录后跳转会给出完整路径（含 hash），不再只说一半

【修复】
· 服务器不可达在每一个环节都被识别为「连不上」，不再误报成「SSO 未配置」
· 成员被移出组织后，本机的团队技能 / 工具 / 模型渠道与 DLP 规则会被清理；此前只有成员自己点「退出企业」才清
· 401 不再被当成撤权：企业服务器重启会让所有 token 失效，此前这会把每一位成员的团队资源一起清掉
· 「我的场景」跟随当前组织上下文，不再串到别的组织
· 退出企业时站内消息会一并清空，不会把上一家公司的通知留在界面上
· 同一个会话第二次分享会更新快照，此前直接报 500
· 审计记录归属到被审计成员所在的租户，此前落在一个占位值上，管理后台按租户筛选看不到

en.d:
[New]
· Pick the image/video model right in the conversation: switch the send box to media mode and change the model in place. Your choice is remembered, and the header dropdown and send box now read from one list, so the two can no longer disagree
· Model-platform presets now sync from the backend's canonical list; Ollama added to the model picker
· The free-trial model gained a metered-proxy vendor and a top-up entry point

[Improved]
· The installed executable and install directory are now consistently named One Work (the shell around the app still carried the previous brand name); the production user-data directory was renamed to match, with an automatic first-launch migration that falls back to the old directory in place if the move fails, so no data is lost
· Multi-image results scale their grid to the image count — columns and height follow the number of images instead of cropping them
· A long model id in the send-box pill is now truncated and marquees on hover instead of crowding the row
· Monochrome agent logos are visible again in dark mode

[Fixed]
· Root-cause fix for "the macOS app is damaged and can't be opened": a signing identity carrying a prefix made signing fail and silently fall back to shipping an unsigned build. Signing failures now abort the release instead
· Corrupted-database recovery now ends the stale process still holding the file and stays retryable after a failure — on Windows this previously dead-ended at "recovery failed"
· Clearing a leftover backend no longer signals unrelated processes that share the name
· A deep link that launches the app via its protocol (dream://) now reaches the already-running window instead of being dropped
· Child processes spawned by the main process no longer flash a console window on Windows
· A custom log directory is now reported accurately, and backend log-level remapping works again
· Images sent through a relay gateway retry on a sibling protocol when the guess is wrong; the video audio parameter was never forwarded, so every video generated through the relay path was silent
· Root-cause fix for installers that extracted no main executable on some machines (E1010)

[New]
· Enterprise onboarding is now a single three-step wizard, with connect and sign-in on one page
· A member-side enterprise memory tab
· Digital-employee team sync, in-org conversation sharing, and admin audit content upload
· Channel sync now carries per-model protocol overrides

[Improved]
· An unavailable SSO channel says why instead of just greying out silently
· Enterprise-issued channel keys are masked on the client
· The wizard's edit mode gained context, a way out, and readable inputs
· Post-login redirects state the full path, hash included, instead of half of it

[Fixed]
· An unreachable server is recognised as unreachable at every step, instead of being misreported as "SSO not configured"
· When a member is removed from the org, their locally materialized team skills / tools / model channels and DLP rules are cleared — previously this only happened if the member clicked "leave enterprise" themselves
· A 401 is no longer treated as revocation: restarting the enterprise server invalidates every token, which used to wipe every member's team resources at once
· "My scenes" follows the current org context instead of leaking across orgs
· Leaving an enterprise now clears the in-app inbox, so a previous employer's notifications no longer linger
· Sharing the same conversation a second time now updates the snapshot; it previously returned a 500
· Audit records are filed under the audited member's own tenant instead of a placeholder, so tenant-filtered views in the admin console can actually see them
